record.paper_title: Open problems on countable dense homogeneity
record.original_question: Is it consistent that there is a filter that is 1/kappa-CDH for some cardinal kappa strictly between 1 and the continuum c?

evidence.quote: Problem 27 (Kunen, Medini and Zdomskyy [53, Question 5]). Is it consistent that there exists a 1 κ -CDH filter for a cardinal κ such that 1 < κ < c?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A filter on the countable set $\omega$ is identified, via characteristic functions, with a subset of the Cantor set $2^\omega$, thereby inheriting a separable metrizable topology. A topological space $X$ is countable dense homogeneous (CDH) if for any two countable dense subsets $D,E\subseteq X$ there exists a homeomorphism $h:X\to X$ with $h(D)=E$. 

For a cardinal $\kappa\geq 1$, say that a filter $\mathcal{F}\subseteq 2^\omega$ is $\tfrac{1}{\kappa}$-CDH if there are exactly $\kappa$ orbits of countable dense subsets of $\mathcal{F}$ under the action of the homeomorphism group $\mathrm{Homeo}(\mathcal{F})$; equivalently, there is a family $\{D_\alpha:\alpha<\kappa\}$ of countable dense subsets of $\mathcal{F}$ such that every countable dense subset of $\mathcal{F}$ is mapped onto some $D_\alpha$ by a self-homeomorphism of $\mathcal{F}$, and $\kappa$ is the least such cardinal. (Thus $\tfrac{1}{1}$-CDH coincides with CDH.) Let $\mathfrak{c}=2^{\aleph_0}$ denote the cardinality of the continuum.

Is it consistent with ZFC that there exists a filter $\mathcal{F}$ on $\omega$ and a cardinal $\kappa$ with $1<\kappa<\mathfrak{c}$ such that $\mathcal{F}$ is $\tfrac{1}{\kappa}$-CDH?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is attributed to Kunen, Medini, and Zdomskyy and is recorded as an open problem in the recent literature on countable dense homogeneity of filters. Searches on related work (Hrušák–Hernández, Medini–Zdomskyy, and follow-up papers from 2024–2025 on CDH filters and topological groups) do not indicate a resolution: the existence of an intermediate $1/\kappa$-CDH filter for $1<\kappa<\mathfrak{c}$ remains unsettled.

status_evidence.title: Countable dense homogeneity and topological groups
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on CDH filters and products of filters, discussing non-meager P-filters and orbit structure under homeomorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: Recent paper on CDH filters does not resolve the intermediate $1/\kappa$-CDH question.

status_evidence.title: Countable dense homogeneous filters and the Menger covering property
status_evidence.snippet: Kunen, Medini and Zdomskyy study CDH filters and pose related questions, including the question reproduced as Problem 27 in subsequent surveys.
status_evidence.claim: The intermediate $1/\kappa$-CDH problem is posed by Kunen–Medini–Zdomskyy.

status_evidence.title: Non-meager P-filters, Miller-measurability, and a question of Hrušák
status_evidence.snippet: Continued investigation of non-meager P-filters relevant to the CDH classification of filters.
